guides.title: Risk Assessment (UK): A Practical Beginner’s Guide
guides.excerpt: What a UK risk assessment is, who needs one, and how to write a simple one that actually helps.
body: A risk assessment is a practical way to identify what could cause harm at work and decide what controls are reasonable.
In the UK, the expectation is that you assess risks and take sensible measures to control them — then keep it under review.
This guide walks you through a simple, repeatable approach and links to a template you can download.
checklist: Describe the task and the setting
Identify hazards (things that can cause harm)
Decide who might be harmed and how
